name: Reflectance NeRF
definition: A neural network that predicts per-channel reflectance modification factors for a surface point, conditioned on its 3D position, viewing direction, lighting direction, and base albedo color.
summary: Reflectance NeRF is a neural network that predicts per-channel reflectance modification factors to explicitly model view-dependent and light-dependent surface properties for synthesizing appearances under varying illumination.
